name: phase
meaning: TrafficJamsPhase: 0 the train is on this station's route (timers run), 1 elsewhere (timers held full)

name: state
meaning: TrafficJamsState: 0 clear (anim 0), 1 jammed (anim 1; the train waits BREAKTIME)

name: switchLatch
meaning: msg 0x1F toggles the state only while 0; msg 0x20 clears it

name: wolfInBox
meaning: Wolf inside BOXSTATION (x/z); edges send Chronometer msg 0x4703

name: etaMs
meaning: estimated time until the train reaches this station, shown on the Chronometer (msg 0x4702)

name: ring
meaning: {self, next (NEXTJAMS), prev2 (msg 0x4682 arg), prev (msg 0x4682 sender)}: ring order in a 4-station loop
